name: Hive 1.2.0
notes: Codex (native) and Hermes (generic CLI) join Claude Code, Pi, and Aider as first-class subprocess agents — bind an @agent to the Codex runtime and it dispatches through codex exec in an isolated worktree, returned as a review-gated diff. Onboarding now detects codex on your PATH and offers it like Claude Code, and you can add it after the fact from Settings -> Models. Plus a published Homebrew tap (brew install --cask honeyhive-ai/hive/hive) and docs for running the headless CLI alongside the app.
